updates.name: Apollo
updates.changelog:
Apollo 4.0.0 | Apollo-Reborn-4.0.0

### Features

- Add **iPhone Duo** support with layouts that adapt to the closed display, open portrait, open landscape and partially folded positions, using the existing Apollo Reborn builds (#1245: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Browse a feed beside its comments, choose Original or Focused content widths, and open the subreddit list in a Standard or Liquid Glass panel
  - Inbox, Account and Settings gain sidebar/detail layouts in open landscape, while Search can keep results beside the page you open
  - Pixel Pals is unavailable on Duo; regular iPhones keep it
- Add an optional **iPad Layout (Beta)** on iPadOS 18 and later, with a native sidebar, adjustable feed and reader columns, and full-width Gallery View (#1385: @jordanearle)
  - Try it from the one-time invitation or turn on iPad Layout under Interface; quit and reopen Apollo to apply it, or turn it off to return to the classic layout
- Add **Restore Reading Session** to reopen your last feed, post and nearby reading position after iOS closes Apollo, including feed and comment sorting (#1441: @Thetromboneman1)
  - On by default under Media → Browsing; explicit links and notifications take priority, and turning it off deletes the saved session
- Add a **Setup Assistant** for new installations to connect or restore, choose Classic, Balanced or Full Featured preferences, select appearance, and review before applying (#1401: @jordanearle)
  - Existing users can open it from Apollo Reborn settings with Keep My Settings selected; updating does not automatically apply a preset
- Rework **Gallery View** with faster opening, pinch-to-resize tiles including a denser four-column layout, and native press-and-hold menus in the grid and fullscreen viewer (#1389, #1434: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Sports clips can play silently in the grid, newly visible tiles start reliably, and returning from a fullscreen image no longer leaves a black screen
- Open **Gallery View** for All Saved or a selected **Saved category**, with empty categories shown without an endless spinner (#1440: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Rebuild **Recently Read** as a native Apollo feed that follows your post layout, thumbnails, text size, themes, swipe actions and menus (#1442: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Open it from its own row on your profile, switch its layout without changing other feeds, clear the history, or remove individual posts
- Add **Recently Visited** subreddits to Search, with configurable section order and limits under Subreddits settings (#1404: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - History clears on restart or account change and is not saved to backups
- Add **Add Downvote Tap** under Posts & Feeds → Info Row so tapping a score can cycle through upvote, downvote and no vote; off by default (#1403: @AcornElf)
- Add a **Subreddit Icon** switch to Compact and Immersive subreddit header layouts, updating the preview and live header together (#1426: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Feature seasonal icons in **Daily Spotlight** around holidays, including Apollo's original holiday icons; the spotlight now shows six picks (#1390, #1245: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Tint **Apollo Reborn maintainer usernames** purple in posts, comments and the Inbox, while retaining their real profiles and normal moderator indicators (#1411: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Make **Bug Reports** attach a removable debug log automatically, and mask usernames, account details, links and sensitive values before logs are exported or shared (#1422, #1423: @icpryde)
  - Export Debug Logs now shares a file that can be attached on GitHub; subreddit names, post/comment IDs and diagnostic details remain readable

### Performance

- Reduce unnecessary **API-Key-Free** requests by fetching subscriptions in larger pages and, with Reduce Rate Limiting on, batching feed avatars by page; interrupted subscription refreshes keep the existing list (#1416: @icpryde)
  - Deleted or unavailable Bluesky previews stop repeatedly fetching themselves and using Reddit requests as a fallback

### Fixes

- Refine **Duo navigation** with steadier feed positions and search bars when columns change, a smoother subreddit drawer, correct Home/Popular/All restoration, and Reddit links opened from Settings routed to Posts (#1470: @nnastasi)
  - Resume videos that were playing before folding or unfolding, covering both shared Reddit videos and direct-player media
- Center **folded Duo title pills** in the usable header and keep composer text clear of the right-hand system strip, with correct wrapping and height through folding and unfolding (#1480: @jordanearle)
- Keep the same **Duo comments thread** when returning from a linked subreddit after rotation or folding, and let the drawer return to an older retained feed correctly (#1464: @jordanearle)

updates.changelog:
UTM 5.0.8 | Universal IPA

## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.

## Changes (v5.0.8)
* Fixed several changes listed for v5.0.7 being left out of that build by mistake.
* (macOS) Fixed Windows 3D acceleration on Apple Silicon Macs without Rosetta by falling back to DXMT
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed Windows installs from the USB CD drive stalling repeatedly, which made them much slower in v5.0.7 (#7970)

## Changes (v5.0.7)
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends with fixes for Windows 3D acceleration
* QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820)
* QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display
* Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad
* (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped
* (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK"
* (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12
* (macOS) Display: The option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen is now available on macOS 12 and later (#6183)
* (macOS) Wizard: Fixed the Name field's focus ring being clipped on the summary page (thanks @dnicolson)
* (macOS 15) QEMU: Better performance on Apple Silicon with the Hypervisor.framework built-in interrupt controller
* (macOS) Scripting: Force stopping a paused VM is now allowed
* (macOS 27) AVF: Explain when a USB device such as a webcam or phone can't be passed through, instead of showing "VZErrorDomain error -6" (#7914)
* (macOS) Guest Agent: Fixed an issue where clipboard sharing fails upon suspend-resume in macOS guests (you need to re-install the latest guest tools) (#7717)

## Changes (v5.0.6)
* Raised the minimum supported versions to macOS 12 and iOS 15 (#7758)
* Updated the DXMT and MoltenVK graphics backends
* Updated the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver, which now requires macOS 26 or iOS 26
* Home: The welcome screen now offers to open an existing VM instead of linking to the gallery
* Snapshots: New Snapshots tab to save, overwrite, restore, rename and delete snapshots of QEMU and Apple VMs. Requires iOS 26 on iOS and macOS 27 for Apple VMs (#5484)
* Settings: Custom QEMU arguments moved to their own page, and the full command line is shown as read-only text that can be copied (#489, #7604)
* SPICE: Fixed microphone audio quality (#7751)
* SPICE: Fixed display and input freezing when audio playback hangs under memory pressure (thanks @evan314159)
* CocoaSpice: Fixed typing into the built-in serial terminal (#7814)
* Terminal: Updated SwiftTerm with a new Metal renderer, and only web links printed by the guest can be opened
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS) Fixed the VM toolbar and external display on iOS 26 and iOS 27

* (iOS 27) Confirm before closing the window of a running VM on iPad

UTM 5.0.7 | Universal IPA

## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.

## Changes (v5.0.7)
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends with fixes for Windows 3D acceleration
* QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820)
* QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display
* Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad
* (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped
* (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK"
* (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12
* (macOS) Display: The option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen is now available on macOS 12 and later (#6183)
* (macOS) Wizard: Fixed the Name field's focus ring being clipped on the summary page (thanks @dnicolson)
* (macOS 15) QEMU: Better performance on Apple Silicon with the Hypervisor.framework built-in interrupt controller
* (macOS) Scripting: Force stopping a paused VM is now allowed
* (macOS 27) AVF: Explain when a USB device such as a webcam or phone can't be passed through, instead of showing "VZErrorDomain error -6" (#7914)
* (macOS) Guest Agent: Fixed an issue where clipboard sharing fails upon suspend-resume in macOS guests (you need to re-install the latest guest tools) (#7717)

## Changes (v5.0.6)
* Raised the minimum supported versions to macOS 12 and iOS 15 (#7758)
* Updated the DXMT and MoltenVK graphics backends
* Updated the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver, which now requires macOS 26 or iOS 26
* Home: The welcome screen now offers to open an existing VM instead of linking to the gallery
* Snapshots: New Snapshots tab to save, overwrite, restore, rename and delete snapshots of QEMU and Apple VMs. Requires iOS 26 on iOS and macOS 27 for Apple VMs (#5484)
* Settings: Custom QEMU arguments moved to their own page, and the full command line is shown as read-only text that can be copied (#489, #7604)
* SPICE: Fixed microphone audio quality (#7751)
* SPICE: Fixed display and input freezing when audio playback hangs under memory pressure (thanks @evan314159)
* CocoaSpice: Fixed typing into the built-in serial terminal (#7814)
* Terminal: Updated SwiftTerm with a new Metal renderer, and only web links printed by the guest can be opened
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS) Fixed the VM toolbar and external display on iOS 26 and iOS 27
* (iOS 26) Reclaim Space, Compress, Resize and converting imported drives to qcow2 are now available on iOS (#4774)
* (iOS 27) Confirm before closing the window of a running VM on iPad
* (iOS) Display: Long press and pan gestures respond immediately, touches at the screen edges reach the guest, new middle click and right/middle drag actions, and a new "Touch mode (drag to scroll)" (#4738)
* (iOS) Display: Redesigned the keyboard accessory bar to match the iOS 26 keyboard
* (iOS) Input: Game controller Options and Home buttons can now be mapped
* (iOS) Settings: Fixed selecting the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver
* (macOS) VoiceOver now announces file browse fields by their name (thanks @lprazdnik)
* (macOS) Terminal: Added a find bar (Cmd-F)
* (macOS 27) Display: New option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen (#6183)
* (macOS 27) Display: Hot Corners are turned off while a VM is in full screen
* (macOS) Settings: Improved the notes field
* (macOS 26) Settings: The "New…" device menu now matches the sidebar
* (macOS) AVF: Sound input and output can be enabled separately, so "Output Only" no longer switches Bluetooth headphones to headset mode (#7875)
* (macOS 26) AVF: New "Shared Network (VM to VM)" and "Host Only" networking modes (#6975, #7480) (thanks @lovon-spec)
* (macOS 27) AVF: USB passthrough, also available from scripting and utmctl (#3778, #7777)
* (macOS 27) AVF: Run without saving changes (#4201, #7326)
* (macOS 27) AVF: Secure Boot option for UEFI guests (#7874)
* (macOS) Scripting: Snapshots are now scriptable objects, and utmctl gains `snapshot` and `discard-state` commands
* (macOS) Scripting: Create and install macOS VMs on the Apple backend (#6092) (thanks @meisenbarth)
* (macOS 27) Scripting: Set up the user account, automatic login and Remote Login of a new macOS VM on first boot (#7757)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed shared directories set with `update registry` failing to open on Apple VMs (thanks @atkinsam)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed a crash when starting a VM after removing its displays with `update configuration` (#7882)

## Changes (v5.0.5)
* ~~Reverted minimum version requirement imposed by v5.0.4: once again we support versions down to macOS 11.3 and iOS 14.0. However, DirectX support is still limited to macOS 13.0 and iOS 16.0.~~
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* Config: For ARM64 configs, GICv3 is now selected by default. Previously this was only the case for > 8 vCPUs. This improves performance for higher vCPU counts < 8.
* Downloader: Path traversal and symlink checks added when unpacking downloaded ZIP files
* Wizard: scaling is now default to "nearest" when a "classic" computer emulation is created in the wizard and "linear" otherwise. Previously …

updates.name: Streamyfin
updates.changelog:
Streamyfin 0.55.2 | streamyfin-ios

## What's Changed

0.55.2 is another bug fix release. One thing does change: a TV is now signed in from your phone with Quick Connect, so Quick Connect has to be on in your server's dashboard (it is by default) and both devices need this version. The rest again comes out of the crash and error reports, plus a round of fixes to accounts and the Seerr sign-in

Thanks to everyone who reported a problem, and to @Gauvino for the Quick Connect and Seerr fixes!

### ✨ Highlights
- **Signing a TV in from your phone uses Quick Connect**, with a code or a QR code, and no longer sends your password over the local network (#2240) by @Gauvino
- **Freezes of a few seconds when playback starts or resumes** on iOS and tvOS are fixed (#2205) by @fredrikburmester
- **Access tokens are kept out of the app log**, including the logs you export, and entries written by earlier versions are cleaned up (#2103) by @Gauvino
- **Seerr access no longer carries over** to the next account signed in on the same device (#2233) by @Gauvino
- **Quick Connect in Settings** sends the code on its sixth digit and tells you why a code fails (#2246) by @Gauvino
- **Luxembourgish** is available as an app language (#2195) by @Gauvino

### 🎬 Player
- iOS and tvOS: the app no longer freezes for several seconds when playback starts or resumes while the system audio service is slow to answer (#2205) by @fredrikburmester
- Music: tapping a track far down the queue before the rest has loaded no longer fails, and neither do previous and next with repeat all (#2212) by @fredrikburmester

### 📺 TV
- Pairing a TV with a phone goes through Quick Connect: the TV shows a code and a QR code, your phone approves it, and the TV signs in by itself. No password travels between the two devices, and the TV picks its own server (#2240) by @Gauvino
- On the phone, Settings > Log in on TV scans the QR code or takes the code typed in, and the entry now shows on iPhones too (#2240) by @Gauvino
- The TV offers a new code when the old one runs out after ten minutes, and says so when Quick Connect is turned off on the server (#2240) by @Gauvino
- "Save this account" works with a Quick Connect sign-in: the TV asks how to protect the account before showing the code (#2240) by @Gauvino
- The TV signs in as the phone's user, and a TV still on an older version has to be updated before it can be paired (#2240) by @Gauvino
- Switching account on a TV no longer leaves the previous account's Seerr session and plugin settings in place for the next one (#2197, #2233) by @Gauvino

### 🔑 Sign-in & Accounts
- Settings > Quick Connect sends the code on its sixth digit or when you paste one, and shows why a code failed under the cells instead of in a dialog, with the code kept for a fix (#2246) by @Gauvino
- Approving a Quick Connect code while Quick Connect is turned off on the server no longer signs you out. The app tells you it is off instead (#2246, #2247) by @Gauvino
- iOS: the toolbar with a "Default" button above the number pad is gone from the Quick Connect code and the account PIN fields, and a tap beside the field closes the keyboard (#2236, #2242) by @Gauvino
- Settings from the Streamyfin plugin are applied right after signing in, Quick Connect included, instead of at the next refresh (#2197) by @Gauvino
- The Seerr sign-in that follows a login runs right away, and only once (#2197, #2231) by @Gauvino
- One account's Seerr session, and the Seerr and OpenSubtitles keys the plugin gave it, no longer reach the next account signed in on the device (#2197, #2233) by @Gauvino

### ⬇️ Downloads
- An item with nothing to download, like a folder, a photo or a book, shows a message instead of doing nothing (#2210) by @fredrikburmester
- Downloading the last missing episode of a season uses that episode's own version, audio and subtitle tracks, not the first episode's (#2214) by @fredrikburmester

### 🐛 Fixes
- Access tokens are redacted from the app log and from exported logs, and entries written before this update are redacted too. On iOS the name of an external subtitle track carried the token into the log (#2103) by @Gauvino
- Opening a library sends one request with that library's own sort and filters, instead of a first one carrying the previous library's (#2256) by @fredrikburmester
- The Live TV guide and the item counts on library cards load when they open before the session has been restored, instead of staying empty (#2209) by @fredrikburmester
- Streamystats: an answer without results no longer breaks the home recommendation rows and search (#2203) by @fredrikburmester
- A custom link the in-app browser cannot open is handed to the system, and one that nothing can open shows a message instead of doing nothing (#2211) by @fredrikburmester
- Fixed an error after restarting the app when something had been changed while offline, like marking an item as played (#2208) by @fredrikburmester
- iOS: custom header values can be read when the system starts the app in the background on a locked phone, once this version has been opened one time (#2215) by @fredrikburmester and @Gauvino

### 🔧 Build & Infra
- Crash reporting sends less: more network and proxy failures the app can do nothing about are skipped (#2204) by @fredrikburmester
- Routine dependency updates (#1874) by @renovate[bot] and @Gauvino

### 🌍 Translations
- Luxembourgish (Lëtzebuergesch) is available in the language picker (#2195) by @Gauvino
- Ongoing Crowdin sync (#2095, #2213, #2241) by our translators on Crowdin
- Want to help translate Streamyfin? Join us at [translate.streamyfin.app](https://translate.streamyfin.app)

### 🛟 Support & Reporting Bugs

- **Bugs and feature requests:** [open an issue](https://github.com/streamyfin/streamyfin/issues/new/choose). Search [existing issues](https://github.com/streamyfin/streamyfin/issues) first and add to a match if there is one.
- **Questions and help:** [Discord](https://discord.streamyfin.app)

**Include in bug reports:** app version, platform and device, OS version, Jellyfin server version, direct play or transcoding, the media's codecs and subtitle format, which player you used (native or standard), steps to reproduce, and logs or a screen recording if possible.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamyfin/streamyfin/compare/v0.55.1...v0.55.2

updates.name: EscapeOS
updates.changelog:
EscapeOS 0.1.8 | EscapeOS-0.1.8

## EscapeOS 0.1.8

v0.1.0, v0.1.1, v0.1.3, v0.1.4, v0.1.5, and v0.1.6 are unchanged. 0.1.7 was never published; its two fixes are in this release.

### Fixed
- **Import from Files works again for new files and Keep Both.** Since 0.1.6 both failed with "That folder is outside this app's data." An app's container is reported under `/private/var`, and the folder check only stripped that prefix for paths that already exist ([#4](https://github.com/pwnapplehat/EscapeOS/issues/4)).
- **`InvalidHostID` now explains itself.** It means the device does not recognise EscapeOS's pairing file. The message used to blame LocalDevVPN and Wi-Fi ([#5](https://github.com/pwnapplehat/EscapeOS/issues/5)).
- **Sharing a file can no longer delete EscapeOS's own data.** Share wrote into EscapeOS's Documents and replaced whatever had that name, so sharing a file called `Backups` or `pairingFile.plist` removed every backup or the pairing file. Shares now use a private temporary folder.

### Added ([#3](https://github.com/pwnapplehat/EscapeOS/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/pwnapplehat/EscapeOS/issues/4))
- **Search Whole App** finds a file or folder by name anywhere in an app's data.
- **Favorites** at the top of the Apps tab; they still open after an app is reinstalled.
- **Replace / Keep Both / Cancel when pasting** a name that already exists. A folder is never replaced, a file is never replaced by itself, and Replace swaps the file in atomically so a failure leaves the original.
- **Free-space check** before Compress, Share Zip, Duplicate, Paste, Import and Backup, with a clear message instead of a late failure.
- **Share / Save to Files** on each backup.

### Changed
- **Deleting a file now asks first**, naming what will be deleted. Files can opt out with "Delete, Don't Ask Again" (Settings turns it back on); folders and backup archives always ask.

Theos arm64 IPA (iPhoneOS 16.5 SDK, `MinimumOSVersion` 18.0), same build path as 0.1.6. After install, reconnect LocalDevVPN if the list is empty; iPASide places `pairingFile.plist` again after sideload.

**Verification:** built for iOS; 200 automated checks of the path, paste, delete, search, favorites and free-space logic run against the real source; the changes were reviewed independently and its findings fixed. **This build was not run on a device**, so the screens (search, favorites, the paste and delete prompts) have not been seen on a phone.

```

```

updates.name: Battman
updates.changelog:
Battman 1.1.0 | TrollStore

## Battman 1.1.0

In this version, I have finally put something in the 'Analytics' page, added native plug-in support, and fixed a bunch of bugs.

**PLEASE LET ME KNOW** when you want any new features or find any bugs. You can create a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/issues/new) to describe them, especially when something behaves differently on your device.

- Implemented the 'Analytics' page with cards that you can add, remove, resize and rearrange ([#53](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/53)).
- Added ten Analytics cards: live readings, capacity observations, cell voltages, charging sessions, battery discharge, connection and charging states, power readings, time by battery level, charging comparison, and discharge rhythm. Graphs include capacity history and comparisons of complete 20% to 80% charging sessions; available readings depend on your device and its recorded history.
- Added native plug-in support, including `.battman` import, plug-in management, diagnostics and recovery mode. Third-party plug-ins require your approval, and changes take effect after restarting Battman ([#53](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/53)).
- Added the public Plugin SDK and plug-in example sources for developers ([#53](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/53)). Charge Gauge is provided as a **source example**, not as a shipped production plug-in.
- Added a 'Temperature Unit' option: System, Celsius, or Fahrenheit ([#43](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/issues/43)).
- Added `zh_TW` localization and documentation ([#35](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/35)).
- Added 'Export Powerlog' to the charging graph. Long-press the graph to export the available system battery log.
- Improved charging-limit settings, daemon connections and charging controls; unavailable or invalid battery readings now have clearer explanations ([#54](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/54)).
- Fixed potential deadlocks in battery-status callbacks and improved battery refreshes while scrolling ([#39](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/39), [#40](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/40)).
- Improved crash logging for the app, daemon and worker processes ([#38](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/38)).
- Fixed DOD0 units and misleading battery-authenticity warnings, and corrected invalid time-to-empty estimates ([#45](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/issues/45), [#46](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/46)).
- Fixed crashes when reading accessory and UPS battery information, including disconnects during a refresh ([#47](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/47)).

The table below retains the installation-method overview from previous releases. It is **not a complete tested-device list for 1.1.0**; you still need a jailbreak or TrollStore version compatible with your particular device and iOS build.

* Unsupported: Outside Battman's current iOS 12.0 / A11-or-newer baseline.
* Untested: No independently completed device-testing coverage is claimed for this combination.
* Jailbreak: An installation method on compatible jailbroken systems; **Roothide jailbreak was not considered in this list**.
* TrollStore: An installation method using [TrollStore](https://github.com/opa334/TrollStore), where that device and iOS build support it.
* Analytics: Individual readings depend on the hardware and available system logs. Missing readings remain unavailable, and incomplete history is not treated as a complete measurement.

### Choose your package

`com.torrekie.battman_1.1.0_iphoneos-arm.deb`: For your rooted jailbreaks, typically on iOS 12.0 ~ 14.x.

`com.torrekie.battman_1.1.0_iphoneos-arm64.deb`: For your rootless jailbreaks, typically on iOS 15.0 or above.

`Battman.tipa`: The Battman host app for TrollStore. Please notice that **DO NOT install deb and tipa versions at the same time**. You can only keep one installation on your device.

`BattmanPluginSDK-1.1.0.tar.gz`: Plugin SDK source for developers, under the MIT License.

`BattmanPluginExamples-1.1.0.tar.gz`: Buildable source examples, including the SDK Analytics card and Charge Gauge. These are source archives, with no compiled plug-in packages or external plug-ins included in the release TIPA.

Native plug-ins run inside Battman with its permissions. A valid signature identifies the publisher and package, but does not make the code safe. On TrollStore installations, activating an additional native plug-in requires a replacement TIPA containing it; importing a `.battman` package alone is not enough.

Only the `.deb` or `.tipa` package is needed to install Battman. The SDK and example source archives are for developers; the `SHA256SUMS*` files are for verification and do not need to be installed.

updates.changelog:
ByeTunes 2.6 | ByeTunes.v2.6.-.Version.fix

# ByeTunes v2.6 – Favorites, Playlist Pinning & Background Downloads Reworked

Hi guys, here is the 2.6 update for ByeTunes. A good amount of things got added, fixed and improved in this one. You can now properly favorite injected songs, pin playlists from inside ByeTunes, and keep downloads going in the background with a new Picture in Picture window. There were also a bunch of fixes around metadata, library management and database safety.

**Favorites**

There are three new options inside Library Repair:

- **Create Favorites Playlist** creates the Favorites playlist using the right name for your device region.
- **Fix Missing Favorites** repairs songs injected with an older version that you already favorited but that never actually appeared in Favorites.
- **Delete Favorites Playlist** lets you delete that playlist from Library Repair.

Songs injected from 2.6 onwards now get their store IDs during injection, so you can favorite them right away. If the metadata fetcher finds a match, ByeTunes uses the IDs from that match. Songs without a match get generated IDs instead.

**Quick recommendation:** if you have older injected songs that you favorited but cannot find in Favorites, run **Fix Missing Favorites** inside Library Repair.

**Playlist Pinning**

You can now pin and unpin playlists from the On-Device Library. Long-press a playlist or use the Pin button from inside it.

**Keep in mind: pinning and unpinning these playlists needs to be done through ByeTunes. The Pin option inside the Apple Music app does not work for them.**

**Background Downloads**

Background downloads got a big rework. ByeTunes now uses silent audio to keep downloads going in the background, with an optional Picture in Picture window so you can see what is happening after leaving the app.

The window shows the current song's progress, what is next in the queue, and when metadata is being fetched. You can also customize it with themes, your own colors or a background picture. There is a live preview in Settings so you can see how it looks before using it.

This replaces the old background download behavior and Live Activity support. Download progress now shows in the Picture in Picture window.

If the app closes while songs are still downloading, those songs go back to the front of the queue the next time you open ByeTunes.

Pause and Cancel were fixed too. They now properly stop background transfers instead of accidentally starting a fallback download after you already paused or cancelled the song.

**Download Queue & Saving Files**

Downloaded songs now get their metadata as part of the download process. You will see a "fetching metadata" state before the song is marked as done, instead of that work being left to a separate background metadata manager.

A few other things got added or improved:

- **Clear All** for completed items in the queue sheet.
- Preview buttons in the album sheet and artist profile.
- Icons instead of text in the download queue indicator.
- Downloads are now limited to **2 at a time for MP3 and 1 for FLAC**, matching what the server supports. (This is temporal until I can pay for a better provider)
- A **server status banner** appears when the server goes into maintenance. Downloads are blocked while the server is down.
- A new **Save With Fetched Metadata** toggle that writes the fetched tags and cover artwork into the MP3 and FLAC copies you save.

**Metadata Fixes**

Metadata matching got a lot of attention in this update. There were cases where a remix could get the original song's information, or a song could get renamed to a different track from the same album. Those issues should now be fixed.

- Downloaded songs now look up the exact Deezer track and album. An Apple Music match is only accepted if it belongs to the same album.
- Apple Music track matching now checks the title, so songs should no longer get relabeled as another track from that album.
- Apple Music search pages are requested in English so ByeTunes can find the Songs and Albums sections even when using a non-English storefront.
- A Deezer result with missing artwork or an unreadable item no longer causes the entire search to come back empty.
- The broken song.link mapping was replaced with Deezer matching, and download failures now show more accurate messages.

FLAC handling was improved too. Some changes in the downloaded files were causing every song to take the album name as its title when an `ALBUMTITLE` tag was present. That is fixed now.

Album artist is also read correctly from files using the `ALBUM ARTIST` or `album_artist` tags.

**Library Management**

Added sorting, a genre filter and multi-delete to the Library management tab.

Fixed an issue where the library would only show some of your songs, for example just 50 tracks. ByeTunes was only scanning one folder. It now scans all folders so the rest of your songs show up too.

Injected songs now use the file's creation date for a more accurate date.

Deleting songs also cleans up any albums, artists and artwork entries left empty after the deletion.

**Stability, Backups & Database Safety**

There were also several fixes to make injection, transfers and backups more reliable:

- One unreadable local file no longer stops the whole injection batch.
- The export folder is checked before transferring files. If it cannot be used, ByeTunes falls back to its own Exports folder.
- Snapshot backups keep the previous snapshot until the new one finishes successfully, and only replace snapshots of the same kind.
- The heartbeat timeout handles stale connection attempts more reliably.
- Matched songs now save their real catalog ID in `match_redownload_params` instead of placeholder text.

Overall stability and database safety were improved too.

**Cleanup**

The old background metadata manager and its pending import pipeline were removed, since downloaded songs now get their metadata directly during the download process.

The Live Activity extension and download tracking were also removed as part of the move to Picture in Picture, along with the old background download behavior and unused code.

**Official Backend & Building Your Own**

I also added [BACKEND_TERMS.md](https://github.com/EduAlexxis/ByeTunes/blob/main/BACKEND_TERMS.md), which explains how the official hosted backend may be used. **Modified builds need to use their own backend.**

If you are building ByeTunes yourself, `Config.example.plist` is now included as a template for the backend address. The README explains how to set it up.

I also reorganized the project structure. Files are now grouped into proper folders so everything is easier to find and work on. This should help anyone working on their own fork of ByeTunes understand where things are and make changes more easily. I am also considering a bigger rewrite of the app down the road, so this cleanup is a step towards that, but nothing is confirmed yet.

Thanks as always to everyone testing ByeTunes, sending logs and reporting what breaks. Hope you guys enjoy this update.
